features.title: Discover Agents and workspace channels
features.summary: Show live runtime status and whether each Agent actually has its workspace subscription.
failureModes: A missing workspace cwd cannot derive a workspace topic.
An Agent absent from the live registry is not assumed to be complete.

verification.testName: subscribes every Agent in a shared working directory exactly once

features.title: Store and browse passive messages
features.summary: Topic and direct messages remain durable records; explicit Agent reads record read time without acknowledging or starting execution.
failureModes: A stale cursor requires refreshing the conversation.

verification.testName: stores topic messages passively and tracks explicit inbox reads separately from acknowledgements
pages and searches stored conversations without marking messages read

features.title: Post messages from the communication browser
features.summary: A human can seed a topic or send a direct message; the UI receives a storage receipt and does not inject work into an Agent.
failureModes: Invalid or ambiguous targets are rejected.
A successful post may have zero captured recipients.

verification.testName: browses pages without reading or acknowledging and posts as a browser principal

features.title: Read and acknowledge direct messages
features.summary: Messages survive service reopen, explicit inbox reads do not acknowledge, and only the recipient can acknowledge its record.
failureModes: A message recipient mismatch cannot acknowledge another Agent's message.
Legacy notifications are discarded during passive-delivery migration.

verification.testName: keeps direct messages available after reopen until the recipient acknowledges them
migrates old queued and steered records to passive delivery without replaying notifications
migrates schema version 1 records to passive delivery without notification replay
